svg.text: Hollygrove Community Fridge door counter - wiring diagram
Board shown: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 style N16R8 (22 pins per side). Wire to the GPIO NUMBER printed next to each pin. All sensors run on 3.3 V.
RGB status LED on board = GPIO48
future link to the solar inverter (Modbus)
3.3 V ONLY on every GPIO pin.
Never connect 5 V to a GPIO pin.
Pink pins on the board: leave empty
Grey pins are free for later use.
Each load cell plugs into its own HX711
(E+, E-, A+, A-: see the HX711 board labels).
Any sensor here is found automatically
at power-up. A sensor that is not
side): same GPIO numbers, same order.
Leave its microSD slot EMPTY (it uses
see the second table in wiring.md.
